description: This file defines the DeviceConfig class within the cuttlefish::modem namespace, providing static methods for device-specific configuration and file handling related to the modem simulator in the Android Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: DeviceConfig
classes.description: Provides static methods for obtaining device-specific paths and opening cross-platform file streams related to the modem simulator.

methods.name: host_id
methods.description: Returns the host identifier for the device.

methods.name: PerInstancePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns a path specific to an instance, given a filename.

methods.name: DefaultHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for host artifacts given a filename.

methods.name: ril_address_and_prefix
methods.description: Returns the RIL (Radio Interface Layer) address and prefix as a string.

methods.name: open_ifstream_crossplat
methods.description: Opens and returns a cross-platform input file stream for the given filename.

methods.name: open_ofstream_crossplat
methods.description: Opens and returns a cross-platform output file stream for the given filename with an optional mode.
